messages:
Alex M: quick heads-up — spotted a coverage hole for the upcoming holiday weekend covering APAC. EU and APAC primary both overlap PTO windows. we only have one confirmed primary so far; that's risky for evening spikes. Oncall Bot: schedule-scan -> hole detected 2025-07-04 00:00 to 2025-07-06 23:59 APAC primary: NONE, Secondary: Samir
Alex M: we need volunteers or a fallback plan.
Samir: i can take primary 0600-1400 UTC each day (day side), but can't do overnight APAC spikes.
Maria L: i can take saturday overnight 1400-2200 UTC only. sunday i'm out.
Samir: i'll cover saturday/day side and sunday mornings if needed.
Jason P: i can be escalation backup for the full weekend (pages that cross SLO). prefer to avoid being front-line primary.
Priya K: i can be primary sunday 0200-1000 UTC. that plus samir covers early day but we still need someone for sunday 1000-2200 UTC.
Alex M: if nobody volunteers for sunday evening we will enact routing fallback to divert APAC production traffic to us-west dedicated pool with temporary capacity bump and shorter per-token timeouts. also need to suppress noisy non-actionable warnings per runbook. runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/playoff/apac-coverage
Alex M: fallback config snippet we plan to apply if we route to us-west: ```
# temporary routing policy
service.routing.apac_fallback: true
service.routing.fallback_region: us-west-2
service.routing.token_timeout_ms: 12000
``` 
Maria L: if we enable fallback please update the customer-facing template and add a dashboard annotation so Support has context — i'll take the dashboard annotation if someone flips the toggle.
Samir: i can flip the toggle if infra approves CI; otherwise i'll run the CLI to scale the dedicated pool manually: ```
redwood infra scale --pool apac-dedicated --replicas 4 --region us-west-2
```
Oncall Bot: deploy-check -> requires approval from infra-eng
Jason P: i'll approve the PR in ~30m. ping me when it's up.
Priya K: reminder on escalation flow: page -> primary -> secondary -> eng-sre. if primary unresponsive >15m secondary should jump in.
Samir: can we also adjust alert thresholds to reduce noisy token-generation warnings when we have thinner coverage?
Alex M: yes, runbook suggests suppressing non-actionable alerts. see link above.
Alex M: proposed weekend coverage plan:
- Sat: 0600-1400 UTC Samir (primary), 1400-2200 UTC Maria L (primary), Jason P (secondary/escalation)
- Sun: 0200-1000 UTC Priya K (primary), 1000-2200 UTC OPEN (need volunteer), Jason P (secondary)
Samir: i'll post a ping in #eng and #eng-ml to recruit for sunday 1000-2200.
Maria L: i've DM'd two folks in APAC who have helped before; will update thread by EOD.
Jason P: approved infra PR now. Samir, go ahead with CLI if that's faster.
Samir: scaled pool via CLI, health checks green, small cold-start latency bump but within thresholds; monitoring tail for errors.
Maria L: update — one volunteer from eng-ml can cover sunday 1000-1800 UTC; still need 1800-2200 UTC.
Priya K: i can extend coverage to 1800 UTC on sunday if that helps.
Alex M: good. final open slot sunday 1800-2200 UTC. if unresolved by 18:00 UTC Friday i'll put Jason on that slot as primary (he's ok being backup-primary).
Jason P: fine with that.
Oncall Bot: reminder scheduled -> deploy approvals expiring in 45m.
Alex M: action items:
- Jason approve infra PR (Jason)
- Samir run scale or open PR (Samir)
- Maria update dashboard + support template (Maria)
- Alex post to #support and #eng-sre (Alex)
- Priya standby for sunday handoff (Priya)
Alex M: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick swaps over the holiday. drop a reaction if you can take the final open slot.
Maria L: will update in ~20m with final confirmations.
Samir: monitoring healthy, no customer-impact pages so far.
Oncall Bot: thread closed pending final confirmations; reminder will post at 18:00 UTC Friday if slot unresolved.
Alex M: closing out — will post any incident pages or changes here. :tada:
